name: afpacket-raw-sniffer
why: socket(AF_PACKET=0x11, SOCK_RAW) by a non-allowlisted process is the Strategy 1 chokepoint
source: synthetic: shape of normalize() output for afpacket_rawsocket_behavioral.c's socket() record

name: afpacket-eperm-attempt
why: an unprivileged AF_PACKET open rejected with EPERM still emits the socket() record and is the CVE-2016-8655/2017-7308 attempt the rule intends to catch
source: synthetic: afpacket atomic run without CAP_NET_RAW (success=no, exit=-EPERM)

name: afinet-raw-wrong-family
why: an AF_INET (0x2) raw socket belongs to the Strategy 2 rule, not this link-layer one: the a0=0x11 family constraint must be load-bearing
source: synthetic: afinet_raw_socket_behavioral.c surface, AF_INET instead of AF_PACKET

name: afxdp-wrong-family
why: an AF_XDP (0x2c) socket is the Strategy 3 surface, covered by afxdp_socket.yml; the family constraint keeps the two rules disjoint

name: tcpdump-allowlisted
why: tcpdump opens the same AF_PACKET raw socket; the comm allowlist alone must suppress it

name: systemd-networkd-allowlisted
why: systemd-networkd (comm truncated to 'systemd-network') opens AF_PACKET for DHCP/LLDP; the allowlist entry must match the 15-char truncated comm
source: synthetic: systemd-networkd raw socket, comm truncated to 15 chars as auditd logs it

name: execve-noise
why: an ordinary execve shares neither the socket syscall nor the family: a sanity floor that must stay quiet
